top_signals.title: Takaichi announces plan to lower consumption tax rate on food to 1%
top_signals.summary: The decision comes despite opposition party criticism and concerns among fellow LDP members about how lost revenue — ¥5 trillion annually — from the reduction would be covered.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
